column2: AI-guided safe and unsafe dissection zones in laparoscopic surgery
column3: In laparoscopic cholecystectomy, safe dissection depends on reading the anatomy correctly in real time.
column4: With the A-Star Lab team I work on AI-assisted surgical video analysis and safety-zone identification, and taught the annotate-and-train workflow in the computer vision session of the ACS Clinical Congress 2026 hands-on AI course.

column2: A staging framework for metabolic surgery
column3: Candidates for metabolic surgery are still described largely by body mass index.
column4: MOSI is a staging framework for metabolic surgery, released with an open-source staging tool.
column5: Best Oral Presentation Award, Minnesota Surgical Society Annual Meeting 2026, and Poster of Distinction, Balfour Surgery Research Symposium.

column1: AI-ECG and biological age after bariatric surgery
column2: A longitudinal cohort study with Cardiology
column3: Does metabolic and bariatric surgery change biological ageing, beyond weight?
column4: A cross-disciplinary project I led with Cardiology, tracking the AI-ECG-derived biological-age gap after surgery in a longitudinal cohort.
column5: Published in Obesity Surgery (2026). Team Collaboration Award, Mayo Research Fellows' Association, and Poster of Distinction, Balfour Surgery Research Symposium.
